snippet.title: [Solo Leveling: ARISE OVERDRIVE] Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Our all new game, Solo Leveling: ARISE OVERDRIVE, is coming to PC on November 17th!
Experience an aura like you've never seen before with Sung Jinwoo's Monarch Transformation, OVERDRIVE, Co-op, and so much more.
Preorder Now on Steam and Xbox PC, and get ready to level up.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2373990/Solo_Leveling_ARISE_OVERDRIVE/
Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/solo-leveling-arise-overdrive/9mvhcq7cjx01
